Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner – Powerful 9000pa Cordless Cleaning Solution

The Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner is a compact, high-performance cordless vacuum designed for modern cleaning needs. Engineered with a powerful 130W motor and advanced suction technology, this portable vacuum cleaner delivers an impressive 9000pa suction power to remove dust, crumbs, pet hair, and debris effortlessly. With its sleek design, lightweight body, and USB-C input type, it is an ideal solution for home, office, and car cleaning.

Featuring an 8.4V lithium battery, the Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner offers a reliable run time of 15–20 minutes on a single charge, making it perfect for quick and efficient cleaning sessions. Its ergonomic build and net weight of just 390g ensure comfortable handling, even during extended use. Whether you need a handheld vacuum cleaner for daily maintenance or a compact car vacuum cleaner, this model delivers consistent performance.

Key Features of Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner

  • High Suction Power: 9000pa suction for deep and effective cleaning
  • Powerful Motor: 130W motor for strong airflow and dust pickup
  • Battery Voltage: 8.4V rechargeable lithium battery
  • Fast Charging: USB-C input type for convenient charging
  • Run Time: 15–20 minutes of uninterrupted cordless use
  • Dust Bin Capacity: 150ml easy-to-empty dust container
  • Compact Size: Product dimensions – 20cm x 16cm x 6cm
  • Lightweight Design: Net weight only 390g

Compact, Portable & Cordless Vacuum Cleaner

Designed for portability, the Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner fits easily into small storage spaces while offering powerful cleaning performance. Its compact dimensions of 20cm x 16cm x 6cm make it ideal for tight corners, furniture gaps, keyboards, and car interiors. The cordless vacuum cleaner design eliminates the hassle of tangled wires, giving you complete freedom of movement.

As a versatile handheld vacuum cleaner, it is perfect for cleaning sofas, mattresses, desks, shelves, and car seats. The high-speed motor combined with optimized airflow ensures that even fine dust particles are efficiently captured in the 150ml bin capacity, reducing the need for frequent emptying.

Ideal for Home, Office & Car Cleaning

The Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner is an excellent choice for users looking for a reliable car vacuum cleaner or a portable cleaning device for daily use. Its strong suction power easily handles dirt from car footwells, dashboards, and upholstery. For home use, it works efficiently on curtains, carpets, stairs, and hard-to-reach surfaces.

With its USB-C charging support, the vacuum cleaner can be charged using power banks, laptops, or wall adapters, making it extremely travel-friendly. This feature enhances usability for users who prefer modern charging standards and fast power delivery.

Energy Efficient & User-Friendly Design

Despite its powerful performance, the Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner is engineered for energy efficiency. The optimized 130W wattage ensures maximum suction without excessive battery drain. The lightweight 390g build reduces hand fatigue, while the intuitive one-button operation makes it easy to use for all age groups.

The durable construction and premium finish ensure long-term reliability, making this cordless vacuum cleaner a smart investment for everyday cleaning needs. Its modern design complements contemporary interiors while delivering professional-grade cleaning performance.

Why Choose Xech V-Gun Pro Vacuum Cleaner?

If you are searching for a powerful, lightweight, and portable vacuum cleaner, the stands out with its advanced features and compact design. With 9000pa suction, USB-C charging, and a convenient cordless form factor, it offers the perfect balance of performance and portability.
